title: Send required diagnostic data only
description: Limits what Windows sends to Microsoft to the required level. Windows Pro and Home do not accept a lower level.
warning: Settings then shows "Some settings are managed by your organization" on the diagnostics page.

title: Turn off the advertising ID
description: Apps can no longer use a per-user identifier to personalise ads.

title: Turn off tailored experiences
description: Windows stops using diagnostic data to personalise tips, ads and recommendations.

title: Turn off activity history
description: Windows stops recording the apps and files you open and stops sending that history to Microsoft.
partLabels: Do not record the apps and files you open
Do not send your activity history to Microsoft

title: Stop feedback prompts
description: Windows no longer asks for feedback.

title: Disable the Customer Experience Improvement tasks
description: Two scheduled tasks that collect and upload usage data.

title: Disable the compatibility appraiser tasks
description: Scheduled tasks that scan installed programs for upgrade telemetry; the appraiser is known for CPU spikes.
partLabels: Compatibility appraiser, which scans your installed programs

title: Disable the disk diagnostic data collector
description: Scheduled task that sends disk and system information to Microsoft.

title: Disable the feedback tasks
description: Scheduled tasks of the Windows feedback client.
partLabels: Feedback task that runs after a download

title: Stop promoted apps from being installed
description: Windows no longer installs or pins suggested apps and games by itself.
partLabels: Policy: Windows does not install promoted apps
No apps installed silently in your account

title: Hide suggestions in Start and Settings
description: Removes suggested apps in Start, tips about Windows and suggested content in Settings.
partLabels: Promoted apps in the Start menu
Tips and suggestions while you use Windows
Suggested content on other Settings pages

title: Hide tips and ads on the lock screen
description: The lock screen stops showing fun facts, tips and promotions.
partLabels: Fun facts and tips on the lock screen
Suggested content on the lock screen

title: Hide OneDrive and Microsoft 365 ads in File Explorer
description: File Explorer stops showing sync-provider notifications.

title: Remove web results from Start search
description: Start search only looks on this PC, which makes it faster and keeps what you type local.

title: Hide search highlights
description: Removes the daily illustrations and suggestions from the search box.

title: Turn off Widgets
description: Removes the Widgets board and its background processes, which hold memory even when the board is closed.

title: Turn off Recall snapshots
description: Windows does not save snapshots of the screen for Recall. Only matters on Copilot+ PCs.
warning: Snapshots that Recall already saved are removed when the policy takes effect.

title: Turn off Windows Copilot
description: Policy that hides the Windows Copilot side panel. It does not affect Claude, Codex or any other AI tool.
warning: Microsoft has partly retired this policy: on recent builds Copilot is an app and is not affected.

title: Keep Game Mode on
description: Windows gives the running game priority and holds back updates and notifications while you play.

title: Turn off background game recording
description: Stops the Xbox Game Bar from recording in the background, which costs CPU and GPU time in games.
warning: Do not apply it if you record clips with the Game Bar.

title: Turn off mouse acceleration
description: Disables "Enhance pointer precision" so the pointer moves the same distance whatever the speed of the hand.
warning: A matter of taste: the pointer feels different on the desktop too.

title: Stop Edge from running in the background
description: Edge no longer preloads at sign-in and no longer keeps running after its last window is closed. Edge and WebView2 keep working.
warning: Edge then shows "Managed by your organization" in its settings.
partLabels: Do not preload Edge when you sign in
Do not keep Edge running after its last window closes

title: Do not upload updates to other PCs
description: Windows Update stops sharing downloaded updates with other computers. Updates still install normally.

title: Turn off Fast Startup
description: Shut down then really shuts down. This avoids stale driver state and helps with WSL and Docker networking problems after a boot.
warning: Starting the PC after a shutdown takes a few seconds longer.

title: Turn off transparency effects
description: Windows draws the taskbar and menus without the translucent effect. A small saving on the GPU.
warning: Cosmetic: Windows looks flatter.

title: Show file extensions
description: File Explorer shows .exe, .ps1, .txt and other extensions, which makes disguised files easier to spot.

title: Add "End task" to the taskbar menu
description: A right-click on a taskbar button offers to end the app without opening Task Manager.

title: Allow paths longer than 260 characters
description: Programs that support it can use long paths, which avoids errors in deep node_modules folders.

title: Stop feedback prompts and extra diagnostic data
description: Stops feedback pop-ups and keeps the device name, diagnostic logs and crash dumps out of the diagnostic data.
partLabels: Do not send the device name with diagnostic data
Limit the diagnostic logs that are collected
Limit the crash dumps that are collected

title: Turn off application telemetry by policy
description: Turns off the application-impact collectors by policy, so an update that re-enables their scheduled tasks does not bring them back.
partLabels: No inventory of your installed programs

title: Turn off the Customer Experience program
description: Turns off the Customer Experience Improvement Program by policy.

title: Turn off more telemetry tasks
description: Turns off more telemetry scheduled tasks (compatibility backup, startup-app tracking, error-report queue, Bluetooth and disk diagnostics).
warning: Windows can switch some of them back on after a feature update; WinModes only changes the ones that exist on this PC.

title: Stop learning from typing and handwriting
description: Windows stops learning from what you type or write and stops reading your contacts for suggestions.
warning: Predictive text and handwriting suggestions become less personal.
partLabels: Do not collect what you type
Do not harvest your contacts for suggestions

title: Do not share the language list with websites
description: Websites no longer receive your list of installed languages.
warning: On a multilingual PC some sites may show only the first language.

title: Do not sync the clipboard across devices
description: The clipboard history stays on this PC instead of syncing to your other devices. Win+V keeps working locally.

title: Stop keeping recent apps and files
description: Stops Windows keeping lists of recent apps, documents and frequent folders.
warning: Quick Access, Jump Lists and Start lose their "recent" entries.
partLabels: Do not track the apps you launch
Do not track the files you open
Hide recent files in Quick access
Hide frequent folders in Quick access

title: Turn off online speech recognition
description: Audio is no longer sent to Microsoft for online speech recognition.
warning: Voice typing (Win+H) and Voice Access stop working online.

title: Stop map downloads and updates
description: Stops offline-map downloads and the Maps update tasks.
warning: Offline maps are no longer updated.
partLabels: Do not download map data on its own
Do not update maps on their own

title: Hide the "finish setting up your device" prompts
description: Hides "Let's finish setting up your device" and the Microsoft-account prompts in Start and Settings.
partLabels: Hide the "finish setting up your device" screens

title: Block promoted apps and welcome pages
description: Stops Windows delivering promoted apps and "welcome" pages after updates. Apps already installed stay.
partLabels: No apps promoted by the PC maker
Forget that promoted apps were once allowed

title: Block Windows promotions by policy
description: Turns off the remaining Windows cloud-content promotions by policy: Settings home, third-party suggestions and tailored experiences.
warning: Some of these policies are honoured only on Enterprise and Education editions; on Pro they are harmless.
partLabels: No tailored experiences from diagnostic data

title: Do not fetch online tips
description: Settings and Explorer no longer fetch online tips and Microsoft help content.

title: Turn off lock screen widgets
description: Removes the news and weather widgets from the lock screen.
partLabels: Widgets chosen by Microsoft for the lock screen

title: Turn off the Share tray and its promotions
description: Stops the Share tray that pops up while you drag files, and the promoted apps in the Share dialog.
partLabels: Share tray when you drag files

title: Block advertising notifications
description: Blocks the advertising notifications (suggestions, backup reminders, Phone Link) without turning off the other notifications.

title: Hide recommended files in Explorer Home
description: Hides the recommended and cloud files from File Explorer Home.

title: Microsoft Edge: stop the promotions
description: Microsoft Edge: no default-browser campaign, first-run page, shopping assistant, rewards or recommendations.
warning: Edge shows "managed by your organization", and these options can no longer be changed in edge://settings.
partLabels: Stop asking to make Edge the default browser

title: Block Recall snapshots by policy
description: Turns off Recall snapshots by policy, in addition to the Recall setting above.
warning: Snapshots that Recall already saved are removed when the policy takes effect.

title: Turn off Click to Do
description: Turns off Click to Do, the AI overlay on the screen.

title: Hide the Copilot button on the taskbar
description: Hides the Copilot button and the Ask Copilot entry on the taskbar.

title: Turn off typing insights
description: Turns off typing insights, the AI suggestions in the input panel.

title: Keep Windows Search off your online accounts
description: Windows Search stops querying your Microsoft and work accounts and stays on this PC.
warning: You can no longer find cloud-only mail or files from the Start menu.
partLabels: Do not search your Microsoft account
Do not search your work or school account

title: Do not keep a search history
description: Start search stops keeping a history of what you searched on this device.
warning: Existing history is not deleted by this setting.

title: Turn off the AI agent in Settings
description: Keeps Settings search a plain keyword search by turning off its AI agent.
warning: May only be honoured on some editions of Windows 11.

title: Turn off AI in Notepad
description: Removes the AI buttons (Rewrite, Summarize, Write) from Notepad without uninstalling anything.

title: Microsoft Edge: turn off the AI features
description: Microsoft Edge: no Copilot sidebar, no page sharing with Copilot, no AI themes and no local AI model download. Edge and WebView2 keep working.
warning: Edge shows "managed by your organization".
partLabels: Copilot cannot read the page you view
Copilot cannot read pages through the browser protocol
Work Copilot cannot read the page you view
Hide the Microsoft 365 Copilot chat icon
No AI search in your browsing history
Do not share browsing history with Copilot search
Do not download the local AI model

title: Start the startup apps without delay
description: Removes the built-in delay of about ten seconds before the startup apps launch after you sign in.
warning: All startup apps then compete for the CPU and disk at once, so the desktop can feel slower for the first seconds.

title: Turn off AutoPlay
description: Stops Windows launching something by itself when you plug in a USB drive or insert a disc.

title: Stop the Sticky Keys pop-ups
description: Stops the Sticky Keys, Filter Keys and Toggle Keys pop-ups that appear when Shift is pressed five times or held.
warning: Leave it off if you rely on these accessibility shortcuts. Takes effect at the next sign-in.

title: Turn off more interface animations
description: Switches off the taskbar animations, the shadows in lists and Aero Peek.
warning: Aero Peek off also removes the preview when you hover a taskbar thumbnail.

title: Do not preload File Explorer
description: Windows no longer keeps File Explorer loaded in the background.
warning: The first Explorer window can open a moment later.

title: Show hidden files and folders
description: Shows hidden files and folders (.git, .env, .vscode, AppData).

title: Open File Explorer on This PC
description: Opens File Explorer on This PC instead of Home, with the drives one click away.

title: Show the full path in the Explorer title
description: Shows the full folder path in the title bar of File Explorer.

title: Use compact spacing in File Explorer
description: Uses compact spacing in File Explorer lists, so more items fit.

title: Alt+Tab without browser tabs
description: Alt+Tab lists windows only, not the tabs of Edge.

title: Turn off the snap layout pop-ups
description: Turns off the snap suggestions and the layout pop-up when you hover the maximize button.
partLabels: Snap layouts on the maximize button
Snap bar when you drag a window

title: Hide the Task View button
description: Hides the Task View button on the taskbar.

title: Shrink the taskbar search box
description: Shrinks the taskbar search box to an icon.

title: Hide the app lists in Start
description: Hides the "Recently added" and "Most used" app lists in Start.

title: Visual Studio: turn off the telemetry
description: Visual Studio: turns off the feedback dialogs and the telemetry by policy. Visual Studio itself behaves the same.

title: Turn off the Bing and Cortana search switches
description: Turns off the user-level Bing, Cortana-consent and search-location switches of Windows Search.
warning: On recent Windows 11 builds the web results are controlled by other switches too; this one is the legacy switch.
partLabels: No Bing results in Start search
Search does not use your location

title: Do not download device apps and icons
description: Plugging in a mouse, keyboard or monitor no longer downloads apps and icons from the device maker.
warning: Install the companion app of a device yourself when you want it.

title: Turn off Windows Error Reporting
description: Stops Windows Error Reporting uploading crash data, and turns off its queue task.
warning: Check that local crash dumps still work if you rely on them for debugging.
partLabels: Do not send extra data with error reports

title: Block Game Bar recording by policy
description: Blocks Game Bar recording and broadcasting by policy, even if a game or the Game Bar switches the per-user flags back on.
warning: Win+Alt+R clip recording stops working. Do not turn it on if you record clips.

title: Keep the game sound during calls
description: Windows no longer lowers the game sound when Discord, Teams or a call app opens a voice stream.
warning: The voice and the game then play at the same loudness. Applies at the next sign-in.

title: Mute the notification sounds
description: Mutes the notification sound but keeps the pop-ups.

title: Stop the controller button opening Game Bar
description: A controller button no longer opens the Game Bar.

title: Do not disturb
description: Do not disturb: no notification pop-ups at all, for example over a game or a presentation.
warning: Also silences the notifications of your AI tools until you turn it off again.

title: Hide OneDrive in File Explorer
description: Removes the OneDrive entry from the navigation pane of File Explorer. OneDrive keeps working.
partLabels: Hide OneDrive in the navigation pane
Hide OneDrive in the navigation pane of 32-bit apps

title: Keep OneDrive from syncing and starting
description: A policy that stops OneDrive from syncing and from starting, and hides it from File Explorer. Nothing is uninstalled; undo it to use OneDrive again.
warning: Files that are only in the cloud cannot be opened while this is on, and apps that save to OneDrive stop doing so.
